spy_5fc8938bd7e3.title: Machine Learning Engineer, NVH
spy_5fc8938bd7e3.description:
**What to Expect**  

Tesla's Noise, Vibration, and Harshness (NVH) team is seeking a passionate and skilled


Machine Learning Engineer to help define the future of diagnostics for Tesla's products.


You will work at the intersection of deep learning research and real\-world manufacturing


deployment, building systems that directly impact product quality and customer


experience at scale.

 **What You'll Do*** Design, develop, and deploy machine learning models and audio algorithms for advanced NVH diagnostics across Tesla's vehicle and product lineup
* Build and maintain end\-to\-end ML pipelines — from raw audio data ingestion and preprocessing to model training, evaluation, and production deployment
* Collaborate cross\-functionally with manufacturing, quality audit, and vehicle engineering teams to integrate diagnostic algorithms into Tesla's production lines
* Drive continuous improvement of model performance through rigorous experimentation, iteration, and ablation studies
*
